prompt:
Image 1 is a finished game sprite sheet of a leader whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees), the direction every figure faces, every figure's pose, size and position in its cell, the 4 by 4 grid and the flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background.
Image 2 is this leader's own approved painted portrait. Every figure of Image 1 must become the man of the portrait, seen full length from above.

Repaint every figure of Image 1 as the man of Image 2, the same in every cell. Keep each figure's pose, the position of its arms, legs and weapon, and its outline as close as the new kit allows. He has these marks, and each one must be clearly visible at full size: (1) the helm of layered bark plates with a pair of antlers; (2) his short beard with moss in it and a stern mouth; (3) the cloak of green leaves with a few small pale cream blossoms; (4) the round carved bark discs on both shoulders; (5) the armour of layered bark plates; (6) the straight sword with a cross guard of carved antler. He carries no shield. Paint the marks in the portrait's hand: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, a muted earthy palette; nothing glows. Keep the daylight of Image 1 (a high sun from the upper left, a cool fill on the lower right); do not copy the portrait's candlelight, its dark background or its framing.

Facing, again: every figure in every one of the cells faces the same way, toward us and to the lower left, including the figure that is hit and the falling one; the fleeing figures alone turn away.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor or shadow; no magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the figures. Never: text, labels, grid lines, borders, a floor, cast shadows, blood, extra people, cropped or overlapping figures.
